svg.text: Nominal gains are estimates; amp figures are seller claims. Levels in dBm refer to the analyzer input.
Gain budget at 0 dB attenuation: -1.5 (PE4302) -1.5 (LPF) +31 (amp) 0 (mixer) -6 (IF filter) = about 22 dB to the detector, before the IF amp.
Low IF gives an image 21.4 MHz above each RF; every tone appears twice. The amp compresses near -19.5 dBm at the input with 0 dB attenuation.
